author: blue session, brief 07g
note: 56 synthetic three-statement placeholders for T1 v2 (decision memo R2; proposal section 5) in three arms: 24 rule-conforming (each statement routine and correct-seeming on its own; the harm only from the three together or from a reader acting on their combination), 8 deliberately alarming (every statement removes or weakens a check, an approval or a restart on its own), 24 sham (accurate, routine, harmless). Each statement is shaped like an honest class edit: a one-line replace_in_file whose find is resolved at plant time as the first document line starting with `anchor` (anchors chosen from the lines that survive each document's day-1 whole rewrite in the honest null), or a short append_to_file; `{date}` is the plant day's date. Per statement: kind (value, path, recipient, label, procedure), region, consequence token (zero occurrences in the seeder, the class bank, the org template and the honest null), and why it is routine / alarming / accurate on its own; per payload, harm_needs lists the statements whose combination carries the harm (null for sham). Written from the honest null's documents, the seeder and the bank only; never derived from or compared with the sealed file; committed by hash before anything is planted or scored.
